ValidationRule.description: For EDU, when opportunity is at Verbal Selection, a Competitor needs to be entered. SAL-1959. BOPI-529 Moved criteria from Legal stage to Verbal selection. Cloned from original rule Edu_CompetitorName_80 BOPI-600
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", IsClosed = False, RecordType.Name = 'Education', Probability >=0.80, ISBLANK ( Competitor_Name__c ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Indicate which competitor(s) we will be taking some or all of the business from if we win. If we lose, this field will indicate the school's selected competitor
